def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Place large models by projected maximum KVPR, then improve via moves and swaps."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    for model in sorted(
        models, key=lambda m: (m.model_size, m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True
    ):
        size = model.model_size
        pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
        candidates = [i for i in range(gpu_num) if size <= free[i]]
        if not candidates:
            raise ValueError("Models do not fit in available GPU memory")

        def projected_score(dst):
            return max(
                (load[i] + pressure) / (free[i] - size)
                if i == dst and free[i] > size else
                float("inf") if i == dst else
                load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf")
                for i in range(gpu_num)
            )

        best = min(candidates, key=projected_score)
        placement[best].append(model)
        free[best] -= size
        load[best] += pressure

    def improve_moves():
        """Repeatedly apply the feasible relocation with best maximum-KVPR reduction."""
        for _ in range(len(models)):
            ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf")
                      for i in range(gpu_num)]
            best_score = max(ratios)
            move = None

            for src in range(gpu_num):
                for model in placement[src]:
                    size = model.model_size
                    pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
                    for dst in range(gpu_num):
                        if src == dst or size > free[dst]:
                            continue
                        remaining = free[dst] - size
                        score = max(
                            (load[src] - pressure) / (free[src] + size) if i == src else
                            (load[dst] + pressure) / remaining if i == dst and remaining else
                            float("inf") if i == dst else ratios[i]
                            for i in range(gpu_num)
                        )
                        if score < best_score:
                            best_score = score
                            move = src, dst, model, size, pressure

            if move is None:
                return
            src, dst, model, size, pressure = move
            placement[src].remove(model)
            placement[dst].append(model)
            free[src] += size
            free[dst] -= size
            load[src] -= pressure
            load[dst] += pressure

    improve_moves()

    for _ in range(2):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf")
                  for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best_score = max(ratios)
        swap = None

        for left_gpu in range(gpu_num):
            for right_gpu in range(left_gpu + 1, gpu_num):
                for left in placement[left_gpu]:
                    left_load = left.req_rate / left.slo
                    for right in placement[right_gpu]:
                        right_load = right.req_rate / right.slo
                        left_free = free[left_gpu] + left.model_size - right.model_size
                        right_free = free[right_gpu] + right.model_size - left.model_size
                        if left_free <= 0 or right_free <= 0:

                        score = max(
                            (load[left_gpu] - left_load + right_load) / left_free

                            (load[right_gpu] - right_load + left_load) / right_free
                            if i == right_gpu else ratios[i]
                            for i in range(gpu_num)
                        )
                        if score < best_score:
                            best_score = score
                            swap = (left_gpu, right_gpu, left, right,
                                    left_free, right_free, left_load, right_load)

        if swap is None:
            break
        left_gpu, right_gpu, left, right, left_free, right_free, left_load, right_load = swap
        placement[left_gpu].remove(left)
        placement[right_gpu].remove(right)
        placement[left_gpu].append(right)
        placement[right_gpu].append(left)
        free[left_gpu], free[right_gpu] = left_free, right_free
        load[left_gpu] += right_load - left_load
